newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends mixed, little impact from INRO.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends mixed, little impact from INRO.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Friday, after drifting in narrow ranges amid thin trade, traders said.
Overnight news that the International Natural Rubber Organisation (INRO) is set to intervene in the market to stabilise prices, failed to stimulate interest, they said.
Prices ranged from 0.9 yen per kg lower to 1.1 yen up, with benchmark November ending down 0.3 yen at 133.2 yen.
"Most private investors retreated to the sidelines ahead of the weekend. Benchmark November may test downside support at 132.0 yen next week amid thin interest," one trader said.
